bullets: Added a Freebucks daily streak perk display on the landing screen that renders +N Freebucks as every day as the 7+ day streak reward, or falls back to the session reward copy.
Added BMP and TIFF image refusal or transcoding to PNG across the CLI and SDK, so BMP and TIFF reach vision providers as PNG instead of 400-ing this turn and on later replays.
Added a Setup to verify guidance box in the CLI for committed, landed, and merged sponsored proposals, replacing the standalone advertiser CTA line.
Added strikethrough list price rendering beside the discounted price on model rows the first-tab discount moved, so users see the original crossed-out price.
